sps-01: Salutations to Shiva as the syllable Na — who wears the serpent-king as a garland, three-eyed, smeared with ash, the Great Lord, eternal, pure, clothed in the directions.
sps-02: Salutations to Shiva as the syllable Ma — anointed with Ganga water and sandal, lord of Nandi and the pramathas, worshipped with mandara and many flowers.
sps-03: Salutations to Shiva as the syllable Shi — auspicious one, sun to the lotus-face of Gauri, destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice, blue-throated, whose banner is the bull.
sps-04: Salutations to Shiva as the syllable Va — worshipped by Vasistha, Agastya, Gautama and the gods; whose three eyes are moon, sun and fire.
sps-05: Salutations to Shiva as the syllable Ya — embodiment of yajña, wearing matted locks, pinaka in hand, eternal, divine, sky-clad.
sps-06: Whoever recites this sacred Panchakshara near Shiva attains Shiva's world and rejoices with Shiva.
